description: This file contains utility functions, constants, and types used across the Mattermost server codebase, including string manipulation, validation, ID generation, JSON handling, and error management.

classes.name: StringInterface
classes.description: A map of string keys to arbitrary values, with JSON serialization and database scan/val methods.

classes.name: StringSet
classes.description: A set of strings implemented as a map for efficient membership testing.

classes.name: StringArray
classes.description: A slice of strings with utility methods for manipulation and database serialization.

classes.name: StringMap
classes.description: A map of string keys to string values with JSON serialization and database scan/val methods.

classes.name: AppError
classes.description: A structured error type with localization, wrapping, and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a string is in the StringSet.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a string to the StringSet.

methods.name: Val
methods.description: Returns the StringSet as a slice of strings.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a string from StringArray.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a string is in StringArray.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two StringArrays are equal.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Converts StringArray to a database value (JSON string).

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Scans a database value into StringArray.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Scans a database value into StringMap.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Converts StringMap to a database value (JSON string).

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes StringMap to JSON.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Scans a database value into StringInterface.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Converts StringInterface to a database value (JSON string).

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes StringInterface to JSON.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of AppError.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Translates the AppError message using a translation function.

methods.name: SystemMessage
methods.description: Returns the system message for the AppError.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the AppError to a JSON string.

methods.name: wrappedToDetailed
methods.description: Appends the wrapped error message to the detailed error.

methods.name: Unwrap
methods.description: Returns the wrapped error.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an error inside AppError.

methods.name: WipeDetailed
methods.description: Clears detailed error and wrapped error.

methods.name: AppErrorFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into an AppError.

methods.name: NewAppError
methods.description: Creates a new AppError with localization.

methods.name: NewId
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID (base32-encoded UUID).

methods.name: NewUsername
methods.description: Generates a new username ID.

methods.name: NewRandomTeamName
methods.description: Generates a valid random team name.

methods.name: NewRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length.

methods.name: GetMillis
methods.description: Returns current time in milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: GetMillisForTime
methods.description: Returns milliseconds since epoch for a given time.

methods.name: GetTimeForMillis
methods.description: Returns time.Time from milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: PadDateStringZeros
methods.description: Pads date string parts with zeros to meet ISO 8601.

methods.name: GetStartOfDayMillis
methods.description: Returns milliseconds since epoch for start of given day.

methods.name: GetEndOfDayMillis
methods.description: Returns milliseconds since epoch for end of given day.

methods.name: CopyStringMap
methods.description: Creates a copy of a string map.

methods.name: MapToJSON
methods.description: Converts a string map to JSON string.

methods.name: MapBoolToJSON
methods.description: Converts a bool map to JSON string.

methods.name: MapFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into a string map.

methods.name: MapBoolFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into a bool map.

methods.name: ArrayToJSON
methods.description: Converts string array to JSON string.

methods.name: ArrayFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into string array (deprecated).

methods.name: SortedArrayFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into sorted string array with duplicates removed.

methods.name: NonSortedArrayFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON into non-sorted string array with duplicates removed.

methods.name: ArrayFromInterface
methods.description: Converts interface{} to string slice.

methods.description: Serializes map[string]any to JSON string.

methods.description: Deserializes JSON into map[string]any.

methods.description: Retrieves server IP address for a network interface.

methods.description: Checks if a string is lowercase.

methods.description: Validates email address format.

methods.name: IsValidChannelIdentifier
methods.description: Validates channel identifier string.

methods.description: Checks if string matches alpha-numeric pattern.

methods.description: Checks if string matches alpha-numeric with hyphen/underscore pattern.

methods.description: Checks if string matches alpha-numeric with plus/hyphen/underscore pattern.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on version and parts.

methods.name: ParseHashtags
methods.description: Extracts hashtags and plain text from input string.

methods.description: Removes <mention> tags from post string.

methods.name: IsCloud
methods.description: Checks if environment indicates cloud installation.

methods.name: SliceToMapKey
methods.description: Converts string slice to map with keys.

methods.description: Limits string to max runes, returns truncated string and truncation flag.

methods.name: LimitBytes
methods.description: Limits string to max bytes, returns truncated string and truncation flag.
